description: MC Full-Ecosystem Intelligent Adaptation Engineer V1.0.4 – A one-stop AI-powered management tool designed specifically for Minecraft mod players and mod pack creators. New users get 60 days of full functionality for free upon first use! Features include: mod search and download, environment setup guidance, Mixin conflict detection, crash log analysis with automatic fixes, support for 12 languages (Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean, Russian, Spanish, German, Italian, Thai, Hindi, Arabic)
